CITY OF ALHAMBRA PLANNING COMMISSION
  ACTION MINUTES

  Regular Meeting
  September 7, 2021

A.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER:  7:00 P.M. via video conference and teleconference

B.  ROLL CALL:

  Present:  Ho, Juarez, Olson, Pham, Sahu, Tang, Tsujii, Wang, Garcia, Gardea

  Absent:  None

  Staff Present: Vanessa Reynoso, Deputy Director; Paul Lam, Principal Planner; Scott
  Quyle, Associate Planner; Alondra Espinoza, Deputy City Attorney

C.  FLAG SALUTE:  Led by President Gardea

D.  CONSENT AGENDA:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 1:  TIME EXTENSION FOR PLANNED DEVELOPMENT PERMIT PD-20-14,
  AND AMENDMENT TO CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT CU-91-16
  • 2000 West Mission Road
  • Applicant: Judy Lee & James Goodman
  • Request: This is a request for a one-year time extension for the
  previously approved Planned Development Permit PD-20-14 and
  Amendment to Conditional Use Permit CU-91-16 to authorize the
  demolition of an existing 12,080 square-foot self-storage building
  (Existing Building “B”) and a 2,024 square-foot partial demolition of an
  existing 26,740 square-foot self-storage building (Existing Building
  “C”) to allow for the construction of a new approximately 69,402
  square-foot self-storage building (New Building “B”) consisting of three
  (3) stories and a single-level basement. The project is located on a
  site of approximately 4.99 acres located in the IPD (Industrial Planned
  Development) zone. (This application is exempt from the California
  Environmental Quality Act.)
  • Recommended Action: Adopt Resolution No. 21-23, approving a
  one-year extension for Planned Development Permit PD-20-14, and
  Amendment to Conditional Use Permit CU-91-16 subject to the
  Conditions of Approval.

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve Agenda Item 1.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Sahu, Seconded by Vice President Garcia.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  1
  09/07/2021
   Roll Call Vote: 10-0-0-0
  Ayes:  Ho, Juarez, Olson, Pham, Sahu, Tang, Tsujii, Wang, Garcia,
  Gardea
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent: None

E.  PUBLIC HEARINGS:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 2:  PLANNED DEVELOPMENT PERMIT PD-21-25, CONDITIONAL USE
  PERMIT CUP-21-15 AND VARIANCE VAR-21-07
  • 2314-2318 West Main Street
  • Applicant: Alastair Martin
  • Request: The applicant is requesting approval of a Planned
  Development Permit, a Conditional Use Permit, and a Variance to
  establish a fitness center known as Mobi-Fit with less than the required
  number of parking spaces within an existing 2,250 square foot
  commercial building, located in the CPD (Commercial Planned
  Development) zone. (This application is exempt from the California
  Environmental Quality Act.)
  • Recommended Action: Adopt Resolution No. 21-20, approving
  Planned Development Permit PD-21-25, Conditional Use Permit CUP-
  21-15, and Variance VAR-21-07 subject to the Conditions of Approval.
  • The public hearing was opened and then closed.
  • Public Comments:
  1.) Ardel Areopagita
  2.) Silvana Balderrama

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve Agenda Item 2.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Sahu, Seconded by Commissioner Olson.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 10-0-0-0
  Ayes:  Ho, Juarez, Olson, Pham, Sahu, Tang, Tsujii, Wang, Garcia,
  Gardea
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent: None

F.  DISCUSSION ITEMS:

  •  There were no Discussion Items.

G.  DIRECTOR’S REPORT

  •  Deputy Director Vanessa Reynoso reminded the public about the upcoming Housing
  Element community meeting scheduled for September 8th at 6:00 p.m., and to register
  through the Housing Element website. The video will be made available on the website
  shortly after the meeting for those unable to attend.
  2
  09/07/2021
 H.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS:

  •  There were no public comments.

I.  COMMENTS FROM THE PLANNING COMMISSION AND CONFERENCE/MEETING REPORTS:

  •  Commissioner Wang inquired if the community outreach for the Housing Element was
  distributed in languages other than English.

J.  ADJOURNMENT:

  •  There being no other business, the meeting was adjourned at 8:10 P.M. to Monday,
  September 20, 2021, at 7:00 P.M.

  _____________________________
  Chris Olson
  President

ATTEST:

_______________________
Karabeth Garcia
Executive Assistant
